description: This PHP class 'ViewMyAttendanceController' extends an abstract controller and manages rendering the 'view-my-attendance' component, setting properties like 'date' and 'is-editable' based on user request and service configurations. It is part of the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin, specifically handling the viewing and possibly editing of attendance records.

classes.name: ViewMyAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the attendance view component, including setting properties based on user inputs and attendance configuration.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, setting properties like 'date' and 'is-editable' depending on request parameters and attendance modification permissions.
